President Opticians is not just a shop for us... it has been part of our family for nearly 50 years. Personally, I have been coming here for over 25 years, and everyone at home wears spectacles that have been trusted only after the power number was checked here.

Late Sashikant uncle was the heart of this place... his knowledge, patience and honesty created a level of trust that is very rare today. For us, getting our eyes checked by him was non-negotiable. Even after his passing, that trust continues through Pratik, who has carried the legacy forward with care and sincerity.

They have a beautiful range of premium frames, but what matters more is the way they guide you... always keeping your comfort, usage, and appearance in mind. The after-sales service is excellent, and they stand by you long after the purchase.

Places like this are becoming rare... built on relationships, not transactions. President Opticians will always have our recommendation.
